Define backup, recovery, and resilience requirements and support validation of recovery procedures and service dependencies. Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, technical security evidence, and architecture reviews with security stakeholders. Review implementation designs and resolve cloud architecture issues throughout development, testing, deployment, and support transition. Experience delivering Government cloud solutions and applying Zero Trust principles and RMF requirements. Ability to distinguish software-as-a-service responsibilities from customer-managed infrastructure and design across those boundaries. Ability to coordinate cross-cloud integrations and communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and dependencies to technical and business stakeholders. Experience supporting D365 F&O integrations or enterprise financial-system modernization. Experience validating cloud services against Government deployment and authorization requirements.
